user.title: Add a CXL001 repeater
user.description: The probe talks through a repeater named BBQZ. Keep that repeater powered and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy, then pick it below. The temperature service is not in the advertisement, so only the BBQZ name is matched.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Confirm CXL001 repeater
bluetooth_confirm.description:
Add **{name}** ({address}), model {model}?

Temperatures are read locally over Bluetooth from the repeater. No cloud account is used. Take the probe off the dock to receive readings.

abort.no_devices_found: No BBQZ repeater found. It has to be powered on and advertising the name BBQZ within range of a Bluetooth adapter or proxy.
abort.not_repeater: That Bluetooth device is not a BBQZ repeater.
